summary: UMH Properties filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a follow-on at-the-market offering of up to $97.5M of its 6.375% Series D Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock ($25 liquidation preference). The filing is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) and does not reflect a special situation event. The offering is an additional issuance of an existing series with identical terms; it lacks an M&A, activist, restructuring, or other transformative trigger. The document is purely a capital raise via preferred equity.
